diagnostic_evidence.quote: is rewritten as a system of nonlinear first-order differential equations with a Lipschitz continuous right-hand side
yields the local existence of a unique solution $\ph \in C^{2}(0,\tilde{t};\Vh)$

issues.failure_explanation: The ODE right-hand side F depends on t through f_p^h(t) and g_abs^h(t), which are only assumed to be in L^2(0,T; ·). The classical (continuous-in-t) Picard–Lindelöf theorem therefore does not apply. A Carathéodory-type argument yields only q^h in H^1, i.e. p^h in H^2(0,T;V_h), not C^2. The same mismatch affects the claim u^h in C^1 when f_u^h and g_in^h are only L^2 in time.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Assume f_p^h, g_abs^h, f_u^h, g_in^h are continuous in time, or weaken the claims to H^2(0,T;V_h) and H^1(0,T;V_h) and invoke the Carathéodory version of the local existence theorem.
issues.overall_effect: The stated time regularity of the semi-discrete solutions, and the cited existence theorem, are unsupported under the stated data assumptions.
issues.title: C^2 (resp. C^1) solutions and classical Picard–Lindelöf claimed with only L^2-in-time discrete data
issues.why_classification: Either option is a standard local change to the hypotheses or the cited theorem. The error estimates and rates are unaffected.

issues.failure_explanation: The chain bounds |κ|‖I_h p‖_∞ via L^∞-stability of the interpolant, which carries a generic constant C≥1. The steps are written with ≲, so the conclusion is only ‖κp^h(t_h^*)‖_∞ ≤ C(h^{q-d/3-ε}+r). This does not imply the strict bound < r+r_0 < 1 needed for membership in A_h.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Use ‖κI_h p‖_∞ ≤ ‖κp‖_∞ + |κ|‖I_h p − p‖_∞ ≤ r + Ch^{q+1−d/2}, as in the proof of Lemma lem: p0 in D, and keep constants explicit in front of r.
issues.overall_effect: The continuation step (p^h(t_h^*) ∈ A_h, hence t_h^* = T) is not justified as written.
issues.title: Non-degeneracy at t_h^* derived with hidden constants multiplying r
issues.why_classification: This is a one-line local correction using estimates already available in the paper. The conclusions are preserved.

issues.failure_explanation: The definition of t_h^* only requires existence and the energy-norm bound; it does not require (p^h,p^h_t)(t) ∈ A_h. A_h-membership is known only up to the Picard time t~, while t_h^* is a supremum and may exceed t~. Moreover, the energy bound with an unspecified C_0 gives only ‖κ(p^h−I_hp)‖_∞ ≲ C_0, not < r_0. The uniform bounds 1−(r+r_0) ≤ 1+κp^h ≲ 1, used in the defect estimate and in the energy argument, are therefore unestablished. A_h-membership is proved only at t_h^* afterwards, using these very estimates.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add (p^h,p^h_t)(s) ∈ A_h for all s ≤ t to the definition of t_h^*. The final estimate then shows strict membership up to t_h^*, which by openness persists beyond it. Alternatively, choose C_0 small relative to r_0.
issues.overall_effect: The bootstrap argument behind the pressure error bound and global existence is circular as written.
issues.title: Membership p^h(t) ∈ A_h on [0,t_h^*] used but never established
issues.why_classification: The repair adds a condition to the bootstrap definition and reuses the estimate already proved. It needs no new lemma, and the rates and scope are unchanged.

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Then integrating in time, employing the bound \eqref{error bound pressure}

issues.failure_explanation: Integrating the energy inequality in time produces the term ‖I_h u_0 − u^h_0‖^2_{L^2}. The theorem places no condition on u^h_0, so the claimed bound ‖u−u^h‖^2 + ∫|u−u^h|^2_dG ≲ h^{2q} fails for generic choices such as u^h_0 = 0. The proof silently drops this term.

failure_location.quote: Let $\fhu$ and $\ghin$ satisfy the accuracy assumptions \eqref{approx properties source terms}.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Assume u^h_0 = I_h u_0, or ‖u_0 − u^h_0‖_{L^2} ≲ h^q, and keep the initial error term in the Gronwall argument.
issues.overall_effect: The concentration convergence statement is false as stated without an approximation property for the initial datum.
issues.title: Concentration error estimate lacks any assumption on the discrete initial datum u^h_0
issues.why_classification: Adding a standard hypothesis on the initial datum restores the result with the same rate and proof.
